scope: Authority classification for governance validators across the Nzila OS monorepo.

classifications.blocking: Failure must fail CI / block the release. Output is authoritative.
classifications.advisory: Failure is reported but does not block; signal-only or budget-tracking.
classifications.deprecated: Superseded by a newer validator. Kept for back-compat or audit replay; output not authoritative.
classifications.future_doctrine: Doctrine validator whose evidence model is not yet wired/sealed; runs in non-enforcing mode until promoted.

notes: This registry is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for which validators carry release authority.
Adding a new validator requires an entry here with explicit classification + rationale.
Promoting future_doctrine -> blocking requires: (1) evidence model documented, (2) green run on main for >= 7 days, (3) PR updating this registry.

gates.purpose: Enforce coherence of nzila-truth-manifest.json against product catalog and registry.
gates.rationale: Truth manifest is the cross-cutting authority for app status; drift here invalidates downstream gates.

gates.purpose: Verify every product/app has an authoritative source-of-truth pointer.
gates.rationale: Prevents orphan truth records and silent authority drift.

gates.purpose: Schema + invariant checks on governance/portfolio/product-catalog.json.
gates.rationale: Catalog is the canonical product list; malformed entries break inventory sync and registry coherence.

gates.purpose: Portfolio-level invariants across catalog, registry, capital allocation.
gates.rationale: Portfolio drift produces misleading capital / commercial reports.

gates.purpose: Verify deployment-inventory and repo inventory are in sync with workspace state.
gates.rationale: Inventory is the source of truth for app topology, deploy targets, and runtime checks. Drift here was the immediate trigger for PR #497.

gates.purpose: Confirm @nzila/platform-auth is the single auth authority; no stray Clerk imports or competing providers.
gates.rationale: Auth authority drift is a security regression class; must block.

gates.purpose: Validate GA-state declarations against actual deploy/runtime evidence.
gates.rationale: Prevents apps from claiming GA without supporting evidence.

gates.purpose: Enforce freshness/provenance/retention policy on evidence artifacts.
gates.rationale: Stale evidence presented as fresh undermines every downstream report.

gates.purpose: Block destructive/unsafe SQL migrations from reaching staging/prod.
gates.rationale: Data-loss prevention; non-negotiable.

gates.purpose: Detect schema drift between Drizzle schema and live DB.
gates.rationale: Drift produces 'Failed query' runtime errors (see drizzle memory note).

gates.purpose: Composite gate: orchestrates the blocking validators below into a single CI signal.
gates.rationale: Single composite entrypoint for the Governance Gates workflow.

gates.purpose: Validate control-plane manifests (jobs, schedules, budgets) for required fields.
gates.rationale: Bad control manifests silently disable critical jobs.

gates.purpose: GA readiness checklist runner.
gates.rationale: Top-level entry for governance composite (see validate:governance script).

gates.purpose: Cross-package contract assertions (truth manifest coherence, no fake production behavior, evidence chain integrity, etc).
gates.rationale: Contract suite encodes invariants assumed by every other gate.

gates.purpose: Subset of contract tests that guard against fake/placeholder runtime behavior.
gates.rationale: Directly enforces the no-placeholder-evidence invariant.

gates.purpose: Enforce per-app maturity.json invariants and truth-manifest coherence.
gates.rationale: Maturity drift is how UE/flagship overstatement enters the system.

gates.purpose: Track total wall-clock and resource budget for governance jobs.
gates.rationale: Budget signal for SRE; should not block release. Note: script invokes with --enforce by default; the --enforce mode is itself currently treated as a soft signal pending budget calibration.

gates.purpose: Cross-checks runtime evidence (health-latest, failure matrix) against declared topology.
gates.rationale: Runtime evidence is staging-only and currently bootstrapEvidence:true; treating as blocking would create false negatives. Promote to blocking once evidence-authority sidecar (reports/runtime/evidence-authority.json) is consumed by this validator.

gates.purpose: Audits runtime authority pointers across apps.
gates.rationale: Useful for drift detection; not yet calibrated for blocking.

gates.purpose: Convergence checks across runtime declarations.
gates.rationale: Superseded by validate-runtime-integrity + truth-manifest coherence; retained for audit replay only. Schedule for removal once historical reports no longer reference it.

gates.purpose: Historical 'final convergence' ladder.
gates.rationale: Authority subsumed by validate-canonical-truth + validate-truth-authority + validate-maturity. Remove after Q2 2026 audit cycle.

gates.purpose: Earlier maturity convergence ladder.
gates.rationale: Replaced by validate:maturity (contract tests).

gates.purpose: Doctrine convergence for institutional cognition layer.
gates.rationale: Doctrine concept; evidence model not yet sealed. Runs but is not authoritative until promoted.

gates.purpose: Labor-continuity governance ladder (UE-adjacent).
gates.rationale: Domain doctrine; not yet wired to release authority.

gates.purpose: Tier-2 hardening convergence checks.
gates.rationale: No tier-2 apps in inventory at GA boundary; promote once any app is classified tier-2.

gates.purpose: Sovereignty proving doctrine.
gates.rationale: Doctrine; evidence model pending. Not authoritative.

gates.purpose: Residual-closure ladder.
gates.rationale: Doctrine; pending closure model.

gates.purpose: Guardrail against overstated operational claims.
gates.rationale: Aligned with truth-manifest coherence; promote to blocking once it consumes truth manifest directly rather than ad-hoc claim scraping.

gates.purpose: Prevents misuse of auth().orgId for app-level org lookups (see Entra Auth Gotchas).
gates.rationale: Encodes a known security/correctness footgun documented in user memory.

gates.purpose: Live operational readiness signal aggregation.
gates.rationale: Useful operational dashboard; not authoritative for release blocking.

gates.purpose: Live infrastructure convergence signal.
gates.rationale: Diagnostic; promote when paired with live-readiness contract.

gates.purpose: UE-specific infrastructure ladder.
gates.rationale: UE-scoped; complements but does not gate the platform composite.

gates.purpose: Navigation/monetization coherence checks.
gates.rationale: Commercial signal; promote when revenue contracts are sealed.

gates.purpose: Composite portfolio governance gate.
gates.rationale: Composite of blocking validators; stays blocking.
